items.title: Does the number of sources matter, or does independence?
items.description: Illustrative model, not a truth calculator: the exam rumor had 3 people repeating it, but 0% of them independently checked — they all just forwarded the same screenshot, which is why it deserved low confidence. Drag the sliders: notice that adding more sources alone barely moves estimated confidence unless a real share of them actually verified against the primary source instead of copying each other.

params.name: numSources
params.label: Number of sources repeating the claim

params.name: independencePercent
params.label: % that verified independently (vs. just copied another source)

items.compute: const independentCount = Math.max(1, Math.round(1 + (params.numSources - 1) * (params.independencePercent / 100))); const confidence = Math.round(100 * (1 - Math.pow(0.6, independentCount))); return { confidence };
